bounds: Two warm-up workers, each launched once, with two abstract clock ticks and two writes. Main-thread admission and replacement are serialized. The model includes an open that completes after cancellation and an admitted write that settles after cancellation.
The Java lifecycle monitor makes output publication and play admission atomic with respect to close. Release records one attempt by the writer and does not promise that Android releases hardware.

Conditional worker progress assumes open, play, write and cleanup settle. The real JVM tests cover the 15-second bound, blocked writes, late opens, play/close ordering, and write failures with controlled output ports. Device timing and playback are outside this model.

assumptions: Weak fairness of each enabled worker advancement. Output-port operations complete or return a failure, including after an abort.
